summary: The Codex control test live_control_request_blocks_until_the_bound_thread_resolves_it waits on the persisted control state rather than a fixed number of pump events. On a loaded host the pump ran ahead of the test, so the release check spent its three reads on events sent before the release and failed in 0.13 s.

replay.detail: Test only; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to restore the event-count waits.
